Motivation:

At the moment we not close the streams once we are done reading which could lead to ta fd leak if the user not explicit close these. We should just close these once we consumed the streams

- Always close the streams
- Add unit tests

pr_comment: Closing this in favor of https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/10983

review_comment: I think it's weird API to close things we didn't open. Open and close should be symmetric in the code.
I am a bit on the fence here as well... Maybe we should just add some docs to `SslContextBuilder` and explain that the user is responsible to close the input stream ?
Adding JavaDoc sounds much better. Because the `InputStream` is created and opened by the User so closure should be done by the User too.
